soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 (thm:tail-atlas)
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem permits alpha_{Sigma,k}=infinity but then asserts a positive lower bound c u^{-alpha_{Sigma,k}}(log u)^{m_{Sigma,k}}, which is undefined absent a convention and false for bounded H_k, whose tail is eventually zero.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 2 (prop:benchmark-reductions)
soundness_flags.one_line: Its finite-support separated-from-Z reduction lies outside the defining absolutely-continuous mover class and exposes the missing bounded-score branch: tail-atlas cannot supply its claimed positive two-sided power laws when H_k is bounded.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:matched-frontier and oeq:feasible-joint-adaptation
